changelog: 1.0.47: home rows are more relevant — a title that fits another row very well may now appear there too (among that row's best 25%, never in the row right above, never as its first card, in at most 3 rows; both adjustable in Home › Rows, 0% = no repeats as before), and the diversity of the main list stops after its first 30 titles so the following rows follow taste. Measured on a realistic bench of 30 accounts: titles matching the account's tastes rise from 37% to 50% in "Movies for you" and from 33% to 38% across the home screen.
